title: Volleyball: Adamson sweeps UP, forces do-or-die in Unity Cup q'finals
summary: Adamson University lived to fight another day in the 2026 Shakey's Super League (SSL) Unity Cup quarterfinals, sweeping University of the Philippines on Saturday at the Muntinlupa Sports Center.
